---
title: Forms and templates
---

Below are some forms and templates you will probably need at some point during your Jornada research.

**Research approval**

To request approval to conduct research at the Jornada, fill out the [ResNotif form](Jornada_resnotif_form.docx) and send to [Conrad Nelson](mailto:cwnelson@nmsu.edu).

**Project management information**

To update the Jornada team about changes to your project use the [ProjectInfo form](Jornada_projectinfo_template.docx). You can send this to the [Jornada IM team](mailto:jornada.data@nmsu.edu)

**Dataset preparation and publishing**

If you are preparing a new Jornada dataset for publication, we strongly recommend using the Environmental Data Initiative's [ezEML](https://ezeml.edirepository.org) application. You can follow our instructions [here](../docs/researcher/prepare-and-publish.qmd). If this is not sufficient for your needs we have metadata templates that you can send to the [Jornada IM team](mailto:jornada.data@nmsu.edu) with your data.

* [MS Word format](Jornada_metadata_template.docx) for relatively simple datasets with few tables.
* [MS Excel format](Jornada_metadata_template.xlsx) for more complex datasets with multiple tables.

**Data requests**

Most data are openly available at the Jornada LTER [website data catalog](https://lter.jornada.nmsu.edu/data-catalog), but some spatial data are restricted access only. To request spatial data, fill out the [Jornada Spatial Data Policy Agreement](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdJijSKE4C9G5pgB__yGelBx5j9OPBSKOoCg4MJP-eb-Isiew/viewform?usp=dialog). You can also request to join the [Jornada GeoPortal](https://jornada-geoportal.nmsu.maps.arcgis.com) with this form.
